title: The Hook's Unexpected Adventure
description: Kayvan and Helbet are busy trying to do something...

mainQuestExcel.title: The Hook's Unexpected Adventure
mainQuestExcel.description: Kayvan and Helbet are busy trying to do something...

dialogs.text: Please try the new bait again, Mr. Kayvan.
I've done that so many times, but the results are just the same as before!
Huh? Why are the two of you fishing together again?
Traveler, we meet again.
Hello, you two.
Have you found out why the fish refuse to take the bait?
Haha! Nope. A researcher and I tried methods like modifying the fishing rod, adjusting the bait, and improving our techniques.
We tried so many different bodies of water and angles... I even tried fishing in a pond full of fish.
But no matter what I did, I could only fish up things that aren't fish.
Don't worry, Mr. Kayvan. Didn't that researcher promise to keep researching? He'll definitely determine the reason behind all this for us.
See, he even designed a new bait for you, and he wants me to stay here with you and record every detail about your fishing process down...
I hope he really succeeds... But until then, I'll just continue fishing my way.
If you would, Traveler, could you get me some more material for bait?
Did you learn anything from the researchers?
What kind of materials do you need this time?
Let me think... I'll use Padisarah this time.
An ordinary one will do.
What kind of materials do you need this time?
Let me think... This time, I need Fresh Harra Fruits for my bait.
There's a place somewhere that has pretty good Harra Fruits. I'll mark it out on your map...
What sort of materials do you need this time?
Let me think... This time, I need... Uh... a Special Sweet Flower.
There's a place with pretty good Sweet Flowers. I'll mark it out on your map...

flow.stepDescription: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogs.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and Padisarah. Did you get them all?
Thank you, please give them to Mr. Kayvan...
Not bad. Now, it's time to fish. I'm gonna catch a big one this time!
Kayvan prepares the bait and begins fishing...
Kayvan catches a wet package a short while later...
Uh... Let me have a look...
Huh? The things in here... They seem like lost items again...
As expected of you.
Uh... We've been fishing ever since Mr. Kayvan and I went to that researcher to modify our bait...
But Mr. Kayvan still fishes up strange things every single time.
Including lost items, ore from the bottom of the river, packages that fell off ships...
Even some adventurer who accidentally fell into the water once grabbed onto Mr. Kayvan's fishing line to get out of the water...
But we just can't catch any fish...
My fishing career has come to its end...
M—Mr. Kayvan! Cheer up! L—Look, the owner of this thing is definitely anxious.
He'll definitely be overjoyed that you fished it up.
We may even be compensated when we take these lost items back to the Adventurers' Guild!
But... I really! I really just want—
I really just want to catch a fish!
"Again"?
I'm feeling pretty good today. It probably won't take long to catch something once I get the materials and make some bait.
I hope you'll be able to catch a fish today...
